graph.name: software_design
graph.description: Pragmatic guidelines for modular, maintainable, and readable software.

nodes.label: Single_Responsibility
nodes.payload: Keep units focused: A function, module, or class should do one thing well and have one clear reason to change.

nodes.label: Side_Effect_Isolation
nodes.payload: Separate pure business logic from I/O and state mutation. Keep functions predictable, testable, and idempotent where possible.

nodes.label: Simplicity_Over_Cleverness
nodes.payload: Write obvious code. Prefer clear, readable solutions over clever abstractions, deep inheritance trees, or premature optimization.

nodes.label: Explicit_Boundaries
nodes.payload: Decouple modules via simple, well-defined interfaces. Changes inside module A should never unexpectedly break module B.

nodes.label: Defensive_Design
nodes.payload: Handle edge cases and errors explicitly at the boundaries. Fail fast with clear error messages instead of failing silently.

nodes.label: Design_Review_Active
nodes.payload: Reviewing code or architecture for simplicity, modularity, and maintainability.
